title: Notes created anywhere appear everywhere
description: A note is the same whether it was created in the browser or through the API.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a note created through the API, when its owner opens the notes page, then the note is listed.
Given a signed-in user, when they add a note on the notes page, then the API returns that note in the user's list.
